scope: Only the order of the zero short circuit changes, for arbitrary component data. Existing root summands, ordered node states, dual signs, curve splits and point allocations are unchanged. Five regressions check three zero slots and one positive and one negative slot. No whole-row or full815 numerical acceptance.
source_snapshot_boundary: Post-validation source/import snapshot. The generic source is byte-identical to the saved final draft; no original pre-build closure snapshot is claimed.
resource_boundary: 120-second simple wrappers reported by the parent run. Their JSON metadata records commands, exit status and child ru_maxrss but no timeout field or sampled RSS monitoring. No sampled build cap is inferred.
